comment: The ONE machine-readable statement of which branches a release consumes, and from which forks.
Why this file exists: the release used to consume ten dependency repositories through three
different mechanisms that could not see each other - Go replace directives in go.mod and
test/go.mod, gitlinks for the three clients, and a nested gitlink inside the Desktop client,
plus the Apple source rule in release/apple-client-refs.env which resolved main at build
time. Nothing compared them, so a pin could lag a fork's product branch for weeks without a
single red build - which is exactly what happened to clients/desktop before v0.1.33.
This file records INTENT (repository + branch + policy). It deliberately records no SHAs:
the SHAs live in go.mod and in the gitlinks, and release/source-lock.json is the snapshot
derived from those. A second copy of a SHA here would be a second truth to keep in sync,
which is the defect the freeze exists to remove.
Moved here from FORK_REPOSITORIES.md and .gitmodules, which stay as the human-readable
inventory and the submodule definitions. scripts/ci/release-freeze.py is the only reader.
policy:
update      - release preparation may move this pin to the branch tip. The move still has
to pass the ABI, module-integrity and build gates; a diverged fork is a
failure, never an automatic merge.
controlled  - never moved by release preparation. Used for the 29 cronet-go native
platform modules, whose archives are built with a Chromium toolchain that
does not exist in this repository; rewriting the SHA without rebuilding and
re-verifying those archives would ship new bindings against old binaries.
report      - resolved and recorded, but never written by release preparation because the
pin lives in ANOTHER repository's tree (Desktop's dashboard gitlink). Moving
it means a commit in that repository first, so the order stays
Dashboard -> Desktop -> kernel.

go_modules.note: sing-box's socket/transport/pause layer. Tracks SagerNet/sing dev.
The option-to-Config pass-through for QUIC; carries the owned-datagram ceiling.
The SagerNet module line only. Never the MetaCubeX line; integration/0.1.45 was merged into sagernet on 2026-11-11.
Tracks MetaCubeX/utls v1.9.0-mod-meta; UPSTREAM.md in that repository is the authority.
The AmneziaWG injection line (awg3-inject) consumed through the fork replace; awg-base/awg-graft were archived and deleted on 2026-11-11 after supersession evidence.
Root module: Go bindings for the native engine. Moves with `all`.

The aggregate module. Its publish commit is one ahead of the root: the first publish commit carries the natives, the second regenerates this module and the lib requires. release-freeze.py verify compares both.

cronet_native.note: The 29 platform archives. They are pinned to an older SHA than the root module on purpose; see go.mod's comment and release/cronet-provenance.txt.

clients.note: One source for iOS and macOS. A formal release must build this exact SHA; release/apple-client-refs.env still allows a manual build to resolve main as a moving target.
Single product branch since the 2026-10-28 convergence.

nested.note: The web UI embedded in the Desktop client. Its pin lives in the Desktop repository, so a lag is reported here and fixed there first.

upstream_mirrors.note: Audit baseline only. mirror/meta-v1.9.0 was archived and deleted on 2026-11-11; main already contains v1.9.0-mod-meta.
The kernel's own upstream. Reported so a release states how far the fork has moved, not to be merged by the freeze.
